say:0:1030102001:0.text: Bring us a gentle wind, the land so fertile ♫
say:0:1030102001:0.source_cn: 带来柔和的风与丰饶的土地~

say:1:1030102002:0.text: Drives away the cold and thieves for a while ♫
say:1:1030102002:0.source_cn: 驱赶寒冬的风与凶恶的盗匪~

say:2:1030102003:0.text: All hearts yearn for Merlin, our true friend ♫
say:2:1030102003:0.source_cn: 所有人都期盼着梅林的归来~
say:2:1030102003:0.male: All hearts yearn for Merlin, our true friend ♫
say:2:1030102003:0.female: All hearts yearn for Merlin, our true friend ♫
